subject: DI03005041

body.en:
Definition

Cement is a finely divided binding material which forms a paste with water and sets/hardens to bind aggregates. Portland cement is a hydraulic cement:its hydration products can develop and retain strength under water. Setting is loss of plasticity; hardening is the subsequent gain of strength.

Properties and hydration

Important properties are fineness, normal consistency, initial/final setting time, soundness, compressive strength and heat of hydration. Finer cement generally hydrates faster, but can increase water demand and heat release. C3S contributes much early strength; C2S contributes later strength; C3A hydrates rapidly and is controlled by gypsum; C4AF influences burning behaviour and colour. Cement notation:C=CaO, S=SiO2,A=Al2O3,F=Fe2O3. These symbols denote phases, not pure elemental carbon or sulphur.

Uses and limitations

Concrete, mortar, plaster, precast products, pavements and structural construction. Choose the cement type for exposure and strength/heat requirements. Curing maintains moisture for hydration; merely adding extra water at placement does not guarantee strength.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

પાણી સાથે paste બનાવી aggregatesને બાંધવા set/harden થતો finely divided binding material એટલે cement. Portland cement hydraulic છે: તેના hydration products પાણીમાં પણ strength વિકસાવી/જાળવી શકે છે. Setting એટલે plasticity ગુમાવવી; hardening એટલે ત્યારબાદ strength વધવી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા Hydration

Fineness, normal consistency, initial/final setting time, soundness, compressive strength તથા heat of hydration મહત્વના ગુણધર્મો છે. Fine cement સામાન્ય રીતે ઝડપથી hydrate થાય છે,પરંતુ water demand/heat વધી શકે છે. C3S early strength, C2S later strength આપે છે; C3A ઝડપથી hydrate થાય છે અને gypsumથી નિયંત્રિત થાય છે; C4AF burning તથા colourને અસર કરે છે. Cement notationમાં C=CaO, S=SiO2,A=Al2O3,F=Fe2O3 છે; આ phase notation છે,elemental carbon/sulphur નહીં.

ઉપયોગો તથા મર્યાદા

Concrete, mortar, plaster, precast products, pavements તથા structural constructionમાં ઉપયોગ. Exposure, strength તથા heat requirement મુજબ type પસંદ કરવો. Curing hydration માટે ભેજ જાળવે છે; placement સમયે વધારે પાણી ઉમેરવાથી strengthની ખાતરી મળતી નથી.

body.en:
Definition and forms

Quicklime is calcium oxide, CaO, obtained by calcining limestone. Hydrated/slaked lime is calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)2,formed by reacting quicklime with controlled water. Limestone, CaCO3,is the feed mineral and is not chemically identical to either product.

Properties and types

Quicklime is a white/grey, alkaline solid; its reactivity depends on feed purity and burning history. Slaking is strongly exothermic. Hydrated lime is a fine white powder, sparingly soluble in water; limewater is the clear saturated solution and milk of lime is a suspension. High-calcium/fat lime has high plasticity; hydraulic lime contains constituents that permit water-resistant setting. Air lime hardens mainly by carbonation, Ca(OH)2 + CO2 → CaCO3 + H2O.

Uses

Mortars/plasters, water and wastewater treatment, soil stabilisation, steelmaking flux, sugar clarification, chemical manufacture and flue-gas treatment. Agricultural lime commonly refers to ground carbonate material; do not confuse its handling with highly reactive quicklime.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સ્વરૂપો

Limestone calcinationથી મળતું calcium oxide, CaO એટલે quicklime. Quicklimeને નિયંત્રિત પાણી સાથે react કરવાથી બનતું calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)2 એટલે hydrated/slaked lime. Limestone, CaCO3 feed mineral છે; તે બંને products જેવું chemical નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા પ્રકારો

Quicklime સફેદ/ભૂખરો alkaline solid છે; તેની reactivity feed purity તથા burning history પર આધારિત છે. Slaking ખૂબ exothermic છે. Hydrated lime fine white powder છે અને પાણીમાં ઓછી દ્રાવ્ય છે; limewater clear saturated solution છે જ્યારે milk of lime suspension છે. High-calcium/fat limeની plasticity ઊંચી હોય છે; hydraulic limeના constituents water-resistant setting આપે છે. Air lime મુખ્યત્વે carbonationથી harden થાય છે:Ca(OH)2 + CO2 → CaCO3 + H2O.

ઉપયોગો

Mortars/plasters, water/wastewater treatment, soil stabilisation, steelmaking flux, sugar clarification, chemical manufacture તથા flue-gas treatmentમાં ઉપયોગ. Agricultural lime ઘણી વખત ground carbonate material હોય છે; તેનું handling reactive quicklime સાથે ગૂંચવવું નહીં.

body.en:
Classification first

Common general-purpose types include ordinary Portland cement(OPC),Portland pozzolana cement(PPC) and Portland slag cement(PSC). Special-duty types include rapid-hardening, low-heat, sulphate-resisting, white/coloured, hydrophobic and high-alumina cement. Type names refer to composition or performance; OPC strength grades are not separate chemical manufacturing routes.

Composition, property and application

OPC is clinker with controlled calcium sulphate:general concrete and mortar. PPC blends clinker with a suitable pozzolan and calcium sulphate:slower early reaction but useful later strength and durability with proper curing. PSC uses suitable granulated blast-furnace slag:often selected for durable construction. Rapid-hardening Portland cement develops early strength, commonly through suitable phase composition/fineness; it is not simply quick-setting cement. Low-heat cement limits heat build-up in massive pours. Sulphate-resisting Portland cement limits reactive aluminate phases for specified sulphate exposure.

Other special types

White cement uses low-colouring raw materials and controlled processing; coloured cement uses compatible pigments. Hydrophobic cement has water-repellent surface treatment to assist storage in humid conditions, but still needs correct mixing/curing. High-alumina cement is a different calcium-aluminate system used for selected refractory/special applications; conversion and design limitations must be considered. No one type is best for every service.
body.gu:
પહેલું વર્ગીકરણ

General-purpose typesમાં ordinary Portland cement(OPC),Portland pozzolana cement(PPC) તથા Portland slag cement(PSC) આવે છે. Special-duty typesમાં rapid-hardening, low-heat, sulphate-resisting, white/coloured, hydrophobic તથા high-alumina cement આવે છે. Type names composition અથવા performance દર્શાવે છે; OPC strength grades જુદી chemical manufacturing routes નથી.

Composition,ગુણધર્મ તથા ઉપયોગ

OPC clinker સાથે controlled calcium sulphate ધરાવે છે: general concrete/mortar માટે. PPCમાં suitable pozzolan તથા calcium sulphate હોય છે: early reaction ધીમી,પણ યોગ્ય curingથી later strength તથા durability ઉપયોગી મળે છે. PSCમાં suitable granulated blast-furnace slag હોય છે અને durable constructionમાં વપરાય છે. Rapid-hardening Portland cement યોગ્ય phase composition/finenessથી early strength આપે છે; તે ફક્ત quick-setting cement નથી. Low-heat cement massive poursમાં heat build-up ઘટાડે છે. Sulphate-resisting Portland cementમાં specified sulphate exposure માટે reactive aluminate phases મર્યાદિત હોય છે.

બીજા વિશેષ પ્રકારો

White cementમાં ઓછા colouring impuritiesવાળો raw material અને controlled processing વપરાય છે; coloured cementમાં compatible pigments ઉમેરાય છે. Hydrophobic cementની surface treatment humid storageમાં મદદ કરે છે,પણ યોગ્ય mixing/curing જરૂરી રહે છે. High-alumina cement અલગ calcium-aluminate system છે; selected refractory/special applicationsમાં conversion તથા design limitations ધ્યાનમાં લેવાય છે. દરેક service માટે એક જ type શ્રેષ્ઠ નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Portland cement is produced by burning a proportioned calcareous/argillaceous feed to clinker and finely grinding the clinker with controlled gypsum.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Limestone supplies CaCO3;clay/shale and corrective materials supply SiO2,Al2O3 and Fe2O3. Fuel, water for the illustrated wet circuit and finish-grinding gypsum are additional inputs.

CaCO3 → CaO + CO2; 2CaO + SiO2 → 2CaO·SiO2(C2S); C2S + CaO → 3CaO·SiO2(C3S). Aluminate/ferrite clinker phases also form.

Primary flowsheet—your supplied PDF, page 4

How to read the supplied drawing

Use the supplied wet-grind circuit, rotary filter, kiln, cooler, clinker storage, peripheral screen and four-compartment finish mill with TWO air classifiers. Do not replace this with a generic dry-process explanation.

1. Raw preparation and the wet circuit in the PDF

High-grade limestone and clay enter the pulveriser and then the tube-mill wet-grinding closed circuit. Water permits slurry handling; the classifier returns coarse material for further grinding. The reference also shows a beneficiated-rock-slurry feed and a rotary-filter branch connected with the feed-preparation section. The rotary filter removes liquid from a slurry where that preparation branch is used; it must not be confused with the downstream flue-gas dust collector. Prepared, composition-controlled material is delivered to the kiln feed end.

2. Rotary-kiln construction and burning

The kiln is a long, inclined, rotating, refractory-lined steel shell. Rotation and slope move feed toward the hot discharge end while hot gases travel oppositely. Feed is dried and preheated, carbonate is calcined, and clinker phases form in the hotter burning zone, typically near1450°C material temperature. Partial liquid formation helps the solid-state reactions and nodules develop. The fuel/flame temperature is not identical to the clinker material temperature.

3. Clinker cooling and waste-heat recovery

Clinker drops into the cooler, where air removes heat and stabilises the clinker structure. Useful hot air can return toward combustion service. Cooled clinker goes to storage. The reference kiln-exhaust route passes through a waste-heat boiler and gas/dust-handling equipment before the stack. Heat recovery and dust separation are distinct duties; the boiler does not remove all particulate matter by itself.

4. Reference finish mill, two classifiers and packing

Stored clinker is ground with controlled gypsum in the four-compartment tube mill shown in the PDF. Its peripheral screen and two air classifiers separate suitable fines from coarser tails; the tails return to the grinding circuit. The reference therefore has two classifiers, not the single grouped classifier in the simplified redraw. Gypsum regulates rapid aluminate hydration during later use. Finished cement is transferred to dry silos and then bagging/shipping; gypsum is not added to the high-temperature kiln as the final set-control dose.

Simplified study redraw—equipment IDs are for this redraw only

Operating and engineering considerations

Control raw-mix chemistry, slurry moisture, kiln feed/temperature, burning-zone stability, free lime, clinker cooling, gypsum dose and final fineness. The original reference equipment is described above; the clean redraw is explicitly a simplified study route. Modern dry/preheater plants are alternatives, not the route shown in the owner drawing.

Applications / uses

Concrete, mortar, plaster, precast units and infrastructure construction, with type/grade chosen for service.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Proportioned calcareous/argillaceous feedને burn કરીને clinker બનાવવું તથા તેમાં controlled gypsum સાથે fine grinding કરવું એટલે Portland cement manufacture.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Limestone CaCO3 આપે છે; clay/shale તથા corrective materialsમાંથી SiO2,Al2O3 અને Fe2O3 મળે છે. Fuel, illustrated wet circuit માટે water તથા finish grinding માટે gypsum વધારાના inputs છે.

CaCO3 → CaO + CO2; 2CaO + SiO2 → 2CaO·SiO2(C2S); C2S + CaO → 3CaO·SiO2(C3S). Aluminate/ferrite clinker phases also form.

મુખ્ય flowsheet—તમે મોકલેલી PDF,પાનું 4

મૂળ drawing કેવી રીતે સમજવી

મૂળ wet-grind circuit, rotary filter, kiln, cooler, clinker storage, peripheral screen તથા TWO air classifiersવાળી four-compartment finish mill પ્રમાણે વાંચો. તેને generic dry-process explanationથી બદલશો નહીં.

1. PDFનો Raw preparation તથા Wet circuit

High-grade limestone તથા clay pulveriser પછી tube-millના wet-grinding closed circuitમાં જાય છે. Waterથી slurry handling શક્ય બને છે; classifier coarse materialને ફરી grind કરવા પાછું મોકલે છે. Referenceમાં beneficiated-rock-slurry feed તથા feed-preparation સાથે જોડાયેલી rotary-filter branch પણ છે. આ preparation branch વપરાય ત્યારે rotary filter slurryમાંથી liquid દૂર કરે છે; તેને downstream flue-gas dust collector ગણવો નહીં. Composition-controlled prepared material kilnના feed endમાં પહોંચે છે.

2. Rotary-kilnનું Construction તથા Burning

Kiln લાંબો,inclined, rotating, refractory-lined steel shell છે. Rotation તથા slopeથી feed hot discharge end તરફ જાય છે,જ્યારે hot gases વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં જાય છે. Feed dry/preheat થાય છે,carbonate calcine થાય છે તથા વધુ ગરમ burning zoneમાં clinker phases બને છે; material temperature સામાન્ય રીતે લગભગ1450°C હોય છે. Partial liquidથી reactions તથા nodules formationમાં મદદ મળે છે. Fuel/flame અને clinker materialનું temperature એક જ નથી.

3. Clinker cooling તથા Waste-heat recovery

Clinker coolerમાં પડે છે; air તેની heat દૂર કરીને structureને સ્થિર કરે છે. ઉપયોગી hot air combustion serviceમાં પાછી વાપરી શકાય છે. Cooled clinker storageમાં જાય છે. Referenceમાં kiln exhaust waste-heat boiler તથા gas/dust-handling equipment પછી stackમાં જાય છે. Heat recovery તથા dust separation જુદાં કાર્યો છે; boiler પોતે બધા particles દૂર કરતું નથી.

4. Reference Finish mill,બે Classifiers તથા Packing

Stored clinkerને controlled gypsum સાથે PDFની four-compartment tube millમાં grind કરાય છે. Peripheral screen તથા બે air classifiers યોગ્ય finesને coarse tailsથી અલગ કરે છે; tails grinding circuitમાં પાછાં જાય છે. મૂળ referenceમાં બે classifiers છે,simplified redrawની જેમ એક grouped classifier નહીં. Gypsum પછીના ઉપયોગમાં rapid aluminate hydration નિયંત્રિત કરે છે. Finished cement dry silos પછી bagging/shippingમાં જાય છે; final set-control gypsum dose high-temperature kilnમાં ઉમેરાતો નથી.

Simplified study redraw—E numbers ફક્ત આ redraw માટે છે

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Raw-mix chemistry, slurry moisture, kiln feed/temperature, burning-zone stability, free lime, clinker cooling, gypsum dose તથા final fineness નિયંત્રિત કરવા. ઉપર મૂળ equipment સમજાવ્યાં છે; clean redraw ફક્ત simplified study route છે. Modern dry/preheater plants alternative છે,owner drawingની route નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Service મુજબ type/grade પસંદ કરીને concrete, mortar, plaster, precast units તથા infrastructureમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

Lime manufacture converts limestone to quicklime by calcination; controlled hydration of some quicklime gives slaked lime.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Sized limestone, fuel/combustion air and controlled hydration water/steam.

CaCO3 → CaO + CO2 (endothermic); CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2 (exothermic).

Primary flowsheet—your supplied PDF, page 5

How to read the supplied drawing

Trace limestone → shaft zones → cooled discharge. Preserve the separate lump quicklime, powdered quicklime and pug-mill/screen slaked-lime branches, including the screen return.

1. Size preparation and shaft-kiln construction

Crushed, sized limestone enters the top of the vertical shaft kiln in the supplied PDF. The refractory-lined shaft contains preheating, calcining and cooling zones. Descending solids exchange heat countercurrently with rising gases. Uniform stone size improves gas distribution; excess fines raise pressure drop and create uneven burning. The exhaust fan shown in the reference removes gases toward controlled dust handling.

2. Calcination, cooling and quicklime products

Hot gases preheat the stone; in the calcining zone sufficient heat decomposes carbonate to CaO and releases CO2. Lime-burning temperatures are commonly in the broad900–1100°C region depending on stone and kiln design, not a universal fixed point. The product is cooled before discharge. A branch gives lump quicklime; another passes through the tube mill to powdered quicklime. Overburning sinters the product and reduces its subsequent slaking reactivity.

3. Pug-mill hydration and classification

Powdered quicklime enters the pug mill with a controlled water/steam supply. Mixing exposes the particles to water while the strong hydration heat is managed. The screen classifier separates acceptable slaked lime; the coarse/incompletely hydrated fraction returns to the pug mill as indicated by the PDF return line. Product is stored dry and protected from uncontrolled moisture/CO2 uptake. The new drawing groups the pug mill as a controlled hydrator.

Simplified study redraw—equipment IDs are for this redraw only

Operating and engineering considerations

Avoid underburnt carbonate cores, overburnt low-reactivity lime, poor gas distribution and uncontrolled slaking. Provide dust control, heat-resistant equipment and guarded discharge. The PDF notes rotary-kiln alternatives, but the depicted unit is a vertical shaft kiln.

Applications / uses

Quicklime/slaked lime for construction, metallurgy, water treatment, soil stabilisation, sugar and chemical industries, according to grade.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Limestoneના calcinationથી quicklime બને છે; તેના એક ભાગના controlled hydrationથી slaked lime બને છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Sized limestone, fuel/combustion air તથા controlled hydration water/steam લેવાય છે.

CaCO3 → CaO + CO2 (endothermic); CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2 (exothermic).

મુખ્ય flowsheet—તમે મોકલેલી PDF,પાનું 5

મૂળ drawing કેવી રીતે સમજવી

Limestone → shaft zones → cooled discharge અનુસરો. Lump quicklime, powdered quicklime તથા pug-mill/screen slaked-lime branches સાથે screen return જુદાં સમજવા.

1. Size preparation તથા Shaft-kiln construction

Crushed, sized limestone મૂળ PDFના vertical shaft kilnની ટોચે જાય છે. Refractory-lined shaftમાં preheating, calcining તથા cooling zones છે. નીચે આવતા solids ઉપર જતા gases સાથે countercurrent heat exchange કરે છે. Uniform stone sizeથી gas distribution સુધરે છે; excess fines pressure drop તથા uneven burning કરે છે. Referenceનો exhaust fan gasesને controlled dust handling તરફ ખેંચે છે.

2. Calcination, cooling તથા Quicklime products

Hot gases stone preheat કરે છે; calcining zoneની heatથી carbonate CaO તથા CO2માં તૂટે છે. Stone/kiln design મુજબ lime-burning temperature સામાન્ય રીતે broad900–1100°C વિસ્તારમાં હોય છે,એક universal value નથી. Product discharge પહેલાં cool થાય છે. એક branchથી lump quicklime મળે છે; બીજી tube millથી powdered quicklime આપે છે. Overburningથી sintering થઈ આગળની slaking reactivity ઘટે છે.

3. Pug-mill hydration તથા Classification

Powdered quicklime controlled water/steam સાથે pug millમાં જાય છે. Mixingથી particles પાણીના સંપર્કમાં આવે છે અને hydrationની તીવ્ર heat નિયંત્રિત થાય છે. Screen classifier acceptable slaked lime અલગ કરે છે; coarse/incompletely hydrated fraction PDFની return line મુજબ pug millમાં પાછું જાય છે. Productને dry તથા uncontrolled moisture/CO2 uptakeથી સુરક્ષિત રાખાય છે. નવા drawingમાં pug millને controlled hydrator તરીકે group કર્યું છે.

Simplified study redraw—E numbers ફક્ત આ redraw માટે છે

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Underburnt carbonate cores, overburnt low-reactivity lime, poor gas distribution તથા uncontrolled slaking રોકવાં. Dust control, heat-resistant equipment તથા guarded discharge જોઈએ. PDFમાં rotary-kiln alternativesની note છે,પણ દર્શાવેલું equipment vertical shaft kiln છે.

ઉપયોગો

Grade મુજબ construction, metallurgy, water treatment, soil stabilisation, sugar તથા chemical industriesમાં quicklime/slaked lime વપરાય છે.

body.en:
Raw mix and kiln behaviour

Poor raw-mix uniformity gives variable clinker phases and strength. Excess moisture in wet feed increases fuel duty. Kiln rings, coating instability, refractory wear and uneven feed upset burning. Control proportioning, homogenisation, feed rate, flame condition and temperature; track free lime rather than judging clinker only by colour.

Energy, grinding and product quality

Calcination and clinker burning consume much thermal energy; grinding consumes major electrical energy. Recover cooler/exhaust heat and avoid false-air leakage. Maintain mill loading, classifier efficiency and gypsum addition; overgrinding wastes power while coarse cement hydrates slowly. Unsoundness can arise from excessive reactive free lime or magnesia; incorrect sulphate balance can disturb setting.

Emissions and handling

Dust arises at crushers, mills, kiln/cooler and packing. Use suitable enclosure, bag filters/electrostatic collection and housekeeping. CO2 comes from both carbonate decomposition and fuel, so a cleaner burner alone does not eliminate process CO2. Monitor permitted NOx/SOx and manage hot surfaces, rotating machinery, noise and alkaline cement dust.
body.gu:
Raw mix તથા Kiln વર્તન

Raw-mix uniformity નબળી હોય તો clinker phases/strength બદલાય છે. Wet feedનો excess moisture fuel duty વધારે છે. Kiln rings, unstable coating, refractory wear તથા uneven feed burningને બગાડે છે. Proportioning, homogenisation, feed rate, flame તથા temperature નિયંત્રિત કરવા; ફક્ત colourને બદલે free lime પણ તપાસવો.

Energy, grinding તથા Product quality

Calcination/clinker burningમાં ઘણી thermal energy તથા grindingમાં electrical energy વપરાય છે. Cooler/exhaust heat recover કરવી તથા false-air leakage રોકવી. Mill loading, classifier efficiency તથા gypsum dose જાળવવા; overgrinding power બગાડે છે અને coarse cement ધીમે hydrate થાય છે. Excess reactive free lime/MgOથી unsoundness અને ખોટા sulphate balanceથી setting સમસ્યા થઈ શકે છે.

Emissions તથા Handling

Crushers, mills, kiln/cooler તથા packingમાં dust થાય છે. Enclosure, bag filters/electrostatic collection તથા housekeeping રાખવાં. CO2 carbonate decomposition તથા fuel બંનેથી આવે છે; cleaner burnerથી process CO2 સંપૂર્ણ દૂર થતું નથી. Permitted NOx/SOx monitor કરવાં અને hot surfaces, rotating machinery, noise તથા alkaline dustના risks નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

body.en:
Aim

Prepare hydrated lime

Principle

CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2;slaking is strongly exothermic and product composition depends on the CaO feed and completion.

Apparatus and approved materials

Teacher-approved guarded hydration vessel, compatible stirrer, thermometer, balance and specified quicklime/water system.

Supervised procedure / process record

Under direct supervision, inspect feed and equipment, carry out controlled hydration strictly by the assigned SOP, monitor heat/physical change and allow the product to reach the approved handling condition. Separate coarse/unhydrated material if required and record product mass/condition. Do not improvise water addition to bulk quicklime.

Observations to record—leave actual values blank until performed

CaO source/purity:____;feed mass:____g; water basis:____;temperature-time record:____;coarse residue:____;product mass:____g; appearance/confirmation:____.

Precautions and evidence

Work only in the supervised institutional laboratory under the instructor-approved SOP and current SDS. Confirm ventilation, PPE, compatible equipment, waste container and emergency arrangements before starting. Do not taste/smell products or invent readings. Illustrative calculation with stated hypothetical data; not an actual practical result.

Given

1000kg dry limestone,90mass% CaCO3,inert remainder;95% conversion of carbonate; M(CaCO3)=100.09,M(CaO)=56.08kg/kmol.

Find and formula

Find CaO formed, not total impure kiln discharge:mCaO=feed×purity×conversion×56.08/100.09.

Substitution and calculation

Carbonate reacted=1000×0.90×0.95=855kg; CaO=855×56.08/100.09=479.0529kg.

Final answer and check

CaO formed≈479.05kg. Unreacted CaCO3=45kg, inert=100kg; total solid discharge≈624.05kg if no other changes occur. CO2 loss≈375.95kg; mass closes to1000kg.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Cement—definition,properties and uses.

a.en: Cement is a finely divided binding material which forms a paste with water and sets/hardens to bind aggregates. Portland cement is a hydraulic cement:its hydration products can develop and retain strength under water. Setting is loss of plasticity; hardening is the subsequent gain of strength.
a.gu: પાણી સાથે paste બનાવી aggregatesને બાંધવા set/harden થતો finely divided binding material એટલે cement. Portland cement hydraulic છે: તેના hydration products પાણીમાં પણ strength વિકસાવી/જાળવી શકે છે. Setting એટલે plasticity ગુમાવવી; hardening એટલે ત્યારબાદ strength વધવી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Lime—definition,properties and uses.

a.en: Quicklime is calcium oxide, CaO, obtained by calcining limestone. Hydrated/slaked lime is calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)2,formed by reacting quicklime with controlled water. Limestone, CaCO3,is the feed mineral and is not chemically identical to either product.
a.gu: Limestone calcinationથી મળતું calcium oxide, CaO એટલે quicklime. Quicklimeને નિયંત્રિત પાણી સાથે react કરવાથી બનતું calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)2 એટલે hydrated/slaked lime. Limestone, CaCO3 feed mineral છે; તે બંને products જેવું chemical નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Types of cement and selection.
q.gu: સિમેન્ટના પ્રકારો તથા પસંદગીની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Common general-purpose types include ordinary Portland cement(OPC),Portland pozzolana cement(PPC) and Portland slag cement(PSC). Special-duty types include rapid-hardening, low-heat, sulphate-resisting, white/coloured, hydrophobic and high-alumina cement. Type names refer to composition or performance; OPC strength grades are not separate chemical manufacturing routes.
a.gu: General-purpose typesમાં ordinary Portland cement(OPC),Portland pozzolana cement(PPC) તથા Portland slag cement(PSC) આવે છે. Special-duty typesમાં rapid-hardening, low-heat, sulphate-resisting, white/coloured, hydrophobic તથા high-alumina cement આવે છે. Type names composition અથવા performance દર્શાવે છે; OPC strength grades જુદી chemical manufacturing routes નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Portland cement.

a.en: Portland cement is produced by burning a proportioned calcareous/argillaceous feed to clinker and finely grinding the clinker with controlled gypsum.
a.gu: Proportioned calcareous/argillaceous feedને burn કરીને clinker બનાવવું તથા તેમાં controlled gypsum સાથે fine grinding કરવું એટલે Portland cement manufacture.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Lime manufacture.

a.en: Lime manufacture converts limestone to quicklime by calcination; controlled hydration of some quicklime gives slaked lime.
a.gu: Limestoneના calcinationથી quicklime બને છે; તેના એક ભાગના controlled hydrationથી slaked lime બને છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Major engineering problems—cement industry.
q.gu: Cement Industryની મુખ્ય Engineering સમસ્યાઓની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Poor raw-mix uniformity gives variable clinker phases and strength. Excess moisture in wet feed increases fuel duty. Kiln rings, coating instability, refractory wear and uneven feed upset burning. Control proportioning, homogenisation, feed rate, flame condition and temperature; track free lime rather than judging clinker only by colour.
a.gu: Raw-mix uniformity નબળી હોય તો clinker phases/strength બદલાય છે. Wet feedનો excess moisture fuel duty વધારે છે. Kiln rings, unstable coating, refractory wear તથા uneven feed burningને બગાડે છે. Proportioning, homogenisation, feed rate, flame તથા temperature નિયંત્રિત કરવા; ફક્ત colourને બદલે free lime પણ તપાસવો.
